description: This file defines the URL class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and key-value handling functionalities. It includes URL scheme enumeration, key-value management, and various URL components accessors.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL, providing parsing, validation, and component access functionalities.

classes.name: URL::KeyValue
classes.description: Handles key-value pairs within URL query strings, supporting key existence, retrieval, and type conversions.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Returns the full URL as a string.

methods.name: URL::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the URL has a valid scheme.

methods.name: URL::Clear
methods.description: Resets the URL components to default.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-encoded format.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into Base64 format.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into components.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL.
